# Model caps (GENERATED: edit the sources, then run the script; do not edit this file by hand)

Written by `scripts/model-caps-report.mjs` from `src/pricing.json` (table as of 2026-09-06; OpenRouter rows compared with its live list on 2026-10-06), `src/reasoning-table.json` (as of 2026-10-07) and `chains/*.json`.
To change a number, edit its source and run `node scripts/model-caps-report.mjs`; `test/model-caps-report.test.js` fails while this file disagrees with them.
One row per model seated in a shipped chain (mock and external seats are excluded). "Price checked" is the first date in the row's own `_source` note, or the table's date when the row has none.

Notes
- "Retry after a cut-off": planning chains double the cap, bounded by the model's own ceiling (`retryCeilingOf`); advice chains bound it at 64,000 (`ADVICE_RETRY_MAX_TOKENS`), never below the cap. "(panel)" is a seat's `panelMaxTokens`, the cap of its review calls.
- "Our cap" is what a chain's seat sets; a seat that sets none gets 36,000 (shown "(default)"). A model's own maximum is the lab's published figure in the reasoning table; the spend cap projects every call at the seat's cap.
- Not in the data yet: the largest reply each OpenRouter endpoint accepts (it can be lower than the model's maximum, and a cap above it narrows routing) and measured speed (tokens per second). Neither is typed here.
